data.body: Every other shared workflow in this repo (`notify.yml`, `issue-triage.yml`, `stale-issue-closer.yml`, `ai-pr-review.yml`, `ai-issue-implementation.yml`) pairs `workflow_call:` with a direct top-level event trigger in the same file, so the automation also fires for this repository's own issues in addition to being callable by consumers. This new workflow defines only `workflow_call:`, so comments on this repository's own closed issues will never trigger a Slack notification unless a separate caller workflow is added later — the feature is effectively inert for the repo that owns it, and inconsistent with every sibling workflow's pattern. Add a direct `issue_comment: types: [created]` trigger alongside `workflow_call:` so this repository dogfoods the same automation it ships to consumers.
